title: “Changing Partners” by Patti Page
text: "Changing Partners" is a pop song with music by Larry Coleman and lyrics by Joe Darion, published in 1953. The best-known recording was made by Patti Page.

title: “Papa Loves Mambo” by Perry Como
text: "Papa Loves Mambo" is a popular song written by Al Hoffman, Dick Manning, and Bix Reichner and released in 1954. The best-known version was recorded by Perry Como with Mitchell Ayres's orchestra in New York City on August 31, 1954.

title: “Shake, Rattle and Roll” by Bill Haley & His Comets
text: "Shake, Rattle and Roll" is a song written in 1954 by Jesse Stone and first recorded that year by Big Joe Turner, whose version ranked No. 127 on the Rolling Stone magazine list of The 500 Greatest Songs of All Time.

title: “Rags to Riches” by Tony Bennett with Percy Faith
text: "Rags to Riches" is a 1953 popular song by Richard Adler and Jerry Ross.
listen: Rags to Riches Tony Bennett with Percy Faith

title: “In the Chapel in the Moonlight” by Kitty Kallen
text: "In the Chapel in the Moonlight" is a 1936 popular song written by Billy Hill, and first performed by Shep Fields. Other successful recordings in 1936–37 were by Richard Himber, Mal Hallett and Ruth Etting.

title: “Here” by Tony Martin
text: "Here" is a popular song, with music written by Harold Grant and lyrics by Dorcas Cochran, published in 1954. The melody was adapted from the operatic aria, "Caro nome," from the opera Rigoletto by Giuseppe Verdi.
